confirmed_cause: New sqlite_case fixture uses Connection as transaction context but never closes the live connections before TemporaryDirectory deletion; Windows WinError32 at effects.sqlite3 cleanup. Real new fixture defect, not unrelated native Tantivy error.
production_retry_assertions: Reached directory cleanup after prior assertions; no assertion failures in artifact.
proposed_fix: Explicit closing context for every real connection, preserving transaction exit/commit before TryAgain; regression verifies closed handles before directory cleanup and rejects old context-only mutant.
